title_en: F-T November Sale Receives Seven Supplemental Entries
description: Fasig-Tipton has released the first batch of supplemental entries for its upcoming November Sale to be held Nov. 2 in Lexington.

title_en: Night of Thunder Colt Tops Tattersalls Book 1 Finale
description: A Night of Thunder colt out of the well-related Capture The Heart went the way of Ace Stud at 2.2 million guineas. The seven-figure youngster was consigned by Luca and Sara Cumani's Fittocks Stud.

title_en: Hall of Fame Jockey Pierce Dies at 89
description: Don Pierce was a prominent member of Southern California's strong jockey colony in the 1960s and 1970s. He won many of California's premier races multiple times, including five consecutive wins in the Los Angeles Handicap.

title_en: Hutch to Succeed Webster as Inglis Managing Director
description: Sebastian Hutch will become managing director of Inglis from Jan. 4, 2027, succeeding Mark Webster as the historic auction house prepares for a significant leadership transition after almost two decades under Webster's stewardship.

title_en: Jockey Spencer Shifts Base From Europe to California
description: Jamie Spencer, a champion rider in Ireland and Britain, has shifted his base from Europe to California. In upcoming action, he has four mounts scheduled over three days from Oct. 10-12 at Santa Anita Park.

title_en: Sheza Alibi Stretches Out in Might And Power
description: Sheza Alibi's co-trainer Katherine Coleman is confident the public will see the best of the 4-year-old mare when she lines up in the Oct. 10 Might And Power (G1) at Caulfield Racecourse.

title_en: Walden, Biancone Part of 'The Good Life Podcast'
description: Elliott Walden, Tom Leach, Jeff Sheppard, and Andie Biancone co-host "The Good Life Podcast" that intersects the worlds of horse racing, mainstream sports, faith, and business.

title_en: Flay Excited to Land Frankel Filly at Tattersalls
description: It is rare for a buyer not named Coolmore or Godolphin to go to a sale and come away with everything that they want. But that is where Bobby Flay found himself, as the three-day Book 1 of the Tattersalls October Yearling Sale concluded Oct. 8.

title_en: Rogue Passion, Musical Times Vie in Fillies' Mile
description: Rogue Passion tackles the Fillies' Mile Stakes (G1) Oct. 9 and heads to Newmarket Racecourse with the hottest form in the book.

title_en: Rileytole Heads Entries for F-T October Digital Sale
description: Fasig-Tipton released its catalog for the October Digital Sale, which includes recent Remington Park Oaks winner Rileytole and half siblings to graded stakes-winning juveniles American History and Dotsy.

title_en: Eight Supplements Added to Keeneland November Sale
description: Keeneland announced Oct. 8 that eight horses have been supplemented to Book 1 of the Keeneland November Breeding Stock Sale Nov. 3. The session, which has cataloged 266 horses, begins at 1 p.m. ET.

title_en: Kentucky Derby Tickets on Sale Noon ET Oct. 8
description: Tickets for the 153rd running of the Kentucky Derby and Kentucky Oaks at Churchill Downs will be available for purchase at noon ET Oct. 8.

title_en: Daryz Rises to Third at World's Best Racehorse Rankings
description: After a second consecutive Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (G1) victory, Aga Khan Studs' Daryz is now third in the latest Longines World's Best Racehorse Rankings.

title_en: Teachintherelease Aims for WV Breeders' Classic Repeat
description: Defending winner Teachintherelease headlines an expected full field of 10 (with two alternates) in this year's renewal of the $300,000 Sam Huff West Virginia Breeders' Classic Stakes Oct. 10 at Hollywood Casino at Charles Town Races.

title_en: Mayberry's Keen Eye Vindicated With Englishman
description: In Beyond the Bidding, BloodHorse sales editor Olivia Newman takes a look at notable trends, accomplishments, and personalities around the North American sales scene.

title_en: Delta Downs' Thoroughbred Season Begins Oct. 9
description: Delta Downs Racetrack will kick off its 2026-27 Thoroughbred season Oct. 9. The track will begin live racing at 4:40 p.m. CT throughout the meeting, which runs through Feb. 20.

title_en: Defensemen Leads Inglis Digital Australia October Sale
description: A 1% share in Ninja, who just defeated Ka Ying Rising in a barrier trial, sells for AU$55,000 at the Inglis Digital Australia October (Early) Online Sale Oct. 7.

title_en: Pappacap Yearlings Make Splash at OBS
description: A total of 267 horses sold for gross receipts of $6,775,500, including private sales, down from last year's total of $7,581,700 from 313 horses to change hands. The average and median both saw increases to $25,376 and $17,000, respectively.

title_en: Curlin to Return to Service on Hill 'n' Dale '27 Roster
description: Hill 'n' Dale at Xalapa announced Oct. 7 its stud fees for the 2027 breeding season, with two-time Horse of the Year and breed-shaping sire Curlin leading the roster.

title_en: Frankel Colt Tops Day 2 of Tattersalls October Sale
description: Coolmore made its first seven-figure signing at the latest renewal of Book 1 when M.V. Magnier secured a Frankel brother to Ylang Ylang at 4 million guineas.

title_en: Jump Seat Soars in Second Start as Hot Prospect
description: Godolphin's Jump Seat, a half sister to dual champion Essential Quality and by 2022 Horse of the Year Flightline, is the latest BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospect after a 2 1/4-length victory Oct. 7 at Keeneland.

title_en: Resilient Caroline St. Beat Returns in Hill Prince
description: Caroline St. Beat is not your typical 3-year-old colt. He's actually the kind of horse who can warm the heart and resurrect memories in the minds of old-time horsemen and fans of the days when horses raced with far more frequency.

title_en: FanDuel to Host Breeders' Cup Preentry Announcements
description: FanDuel TV will host the live announcement of the preentered fields for the 2026 Breeders' Cup World Championships at noon ET Oct. 21.

title_en: Just a Touch Brings Strong Route Record to Sycamore
description: Just a Touch, a son of Justify, has won two stakes this year at the Sycamore Stakes (G2T) distance of 1 1/2 miles.

title_en: Justify Colt Nets $2.2 Million at Tattersalls October
description: If there was any doubt that Justify, one of the leading North American sires, is on the rise as a stallion of consequence in Europe, that was put to rest Oct. 7 on the second day of Book 1 at the Tattersalls October Yearling Sale.

title_en: MD Trainer Corrales Suspended Two Years, Fined $10K
description: Trainer Jose Corrales has been suspended for two years and fined $10,000 by HIWU after an arbitrator found him responsible for a nikethamide positive in Curlene's Spirit following her victory in a claiming race Feb. 20 at Laurel Park.

title_en: Changes Coming for Derby Preps on Belmont Park's Tapeta
description: The New York Racing Association announces the stakes schedule for the 2026-27 winter meet at Belmont Park, which will include 28 stakes races worth nearly $5.7 million in total purses.

title_en: Ag Bullet Aims to Rebound in Franklin
description: The clock is counting down on the remarkable career of Ag Bullet, but trainer Richard Baltas is hoping there are still two shots in the chamber left to fire. The first of those comes Oct. 11 in the $400,000 Franklin Stakes (G2T) at Keeneland.

title_en: G1 Winner, Social Media Star Sandman Retired
description: 2025 Arkansas Derby (G1) winner and social media star Sandman has been retired from racing, according to a social media post by Griffin Johnson, and will stand the 2027 breeding season at Rockridge Stud near Hudson, N.Y.

title_en: Silver Ratio Beats Wonder Dean in Japan Dirt Classic
description: Silver Ratio rallied to win the Oct. 7 Japan Dirt Classic, defeating world travelers Wonder Dean, Finger, and Pyromancer.

title_en: Velazquez Named Jockey of the Week
description: Hall of Famer John Velazquez made the most of his trip for Fall Stars Weekend at Keeneland that included 11 stakes races carded over three days. Five of the stakes races were grade 1. The ageless Velazquez won two as well as a grade 3 stakes race.

title_en: Podcast Playback: Quotes of Interest From Oct. 1-7
description: This week's Podcast Playback looks at quotes of interest from racing podcasts Oct. 1-7, including Barry Irwin, owner of Team Valor International, discussing the decision to skip the Breeders' Cup Juvenile (G1) with U. S. S. Valor.

title_en: Irish Betting Tax Remains Unchanged in 2027
description: The Irish horse racing and betting sectors were among the winners in the Oct. 6 budget, with Horse Racing Ireland's funding due to increase while the rate of betting tax has been left unchanged.

title_en: Luster Set to Sparkle in QEII After King’s Plate Romp
description: Gainesway Stable and Andrew Rosen celebrated a grade 1 victory at Keeneland when Emphatic captured the Oct. 2 Alcibiades (G1). Now, they'll seek another top win when Luster represents them in the Oct. 10 Queen Elizabeth II Challenge Cup (G1T).

title_en: Gonzalez to Ride a Pair for Joseph at Breeders' Cup
description: Jockey Edwin Gonzalez is scheduled to have grade 1 opportunities Oct. 31 at Keeneland, courtesy of trainer Saffie Joseph Jr.

title_en: Sovereignty Still Leads in Largely Unchanged NTRA Poll
description: With many top horses having already completed their final preps ahead of the Breeders' Cup, the latest National Thoroughbred Racing Association Top Thoroughbred Poll shows little movement despite a flurry of graded stakes action last week.

title_en: Three Well-Bred Juveniles Are Latest Hot Prospects
description: Well-bred juveniles Damavand, Winchester Road, and Mystik Bayou are the latest BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after promising victories last week.

title_en: On the Rise: Sam Bussanich
description: In this monthly BH interview, Karen M. Johnson profiles young racing personalities.

title_en: Irwin Details Plan for Champagne Winner U. S. S. Valor
description: During an appearance on the Oct. 5 episode of BloodHorse Monday, Barry Irwin dived into the decision of skipping the Breeders' Cup with Champagne Stakes (G1) winner U. S. S. Valor.

title_en: Q&A: Thompson Aims to Expand Regional Breeding Markets
